comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Setup in any order
themes.text: You can run `nvs run`, `nvs init` and `nvs service install` in any order, and the service starts every time. `nvs init` sets up the data folder and the project file. A command that needs admin rights asks for them itself.

themes.title: Example apps and checked examples
themes.text: The chat app uses WebSockets, and the poll app uses server-sent events. You can start a real project from either one. Every block of code on this website is run by a test, or it says why it is not.
